output.summary: A perennial herb native to Europe, much of temperate Asia and western North Africa. Most subspecies bear hollow hairs on their leaves and stems that cause a painful sting on contact. Young plants and leaves are eaten cooked; soaking or cooking removes the stinging chemicals.
output.edibilityNote: Young plants and leaves are cooked and eaten; soaking or cooking removes the sting. Leaves and flowers are also dried for tea.
